title: Ali Akbar e Laila
body:
Ali akbar e laila, Noore chashma e laila, Maahe anwar e laila..
Yake zakhm ba seena, Labe ahmari tashnaa, Ruqam khaak e ba sehra..
1) Teri shaadi rachati, Ali Akbar e Laila
Tujhe dulha banati, Ali Akbar e Laila
Tera sehra bandhati, Ali Akbar e Laila
Ba har ghum o ba har kham, Tuyii hast o panaahum, Ali akbar e jaanam..
2) Mere laal kaha ho, Ali Akbar e Laila
Wahiñ mujhko bulalo, Ali Akbar e Laila
Utho uth ke azaañ do, Ali Akbar e Laila
Ayaañ khaaliq e subhaañ, Rawad akbar e zeehshañ, Suye lashkar e shaitaañ..
3) Mere gesuwo waale, Ali Akbar e Laila
Meri aankho ke taare, Ali Akbar e Laila
Meri godd ke paale, Ali Akbar e Laila
Rawaañ jaanib e maidaañ, Giraf taaba kashaf jaa’n, Taras aye fi sha’af jaañ..
4) Tujhe teer lagaya, Ali Akbar e Laila
Tera khoon bahaya, Ali Akbar e Laila
Zara rehm na aaya, Ali Akbar e Laila
Gul e aale abaa yast, Maahe karbobala yast, Ya tu noor e khuda yast..
5) Phuphi ghum ki satayi, Ali Akbar e Laila
Teri laash par aayi, Ali Akbar e Laila
Wo hai deti duhaai, Ali Akbar e Laila
Sanam bar suye giryaa, Basar khaak e shaheeda, Manam zaaro pareshaañ..
6) Meri aankho ke taare, Ali Akbar e Laila
Mere ghum ke ujaale, Ali Akbar e Laila
Mere gesuwo waale, Ali Akbar e Laila
Maahe dard e zamaanast, Suye khuld rawaanast, Ba malboos e shahaanast..
Shukr e Maula as
